name: Grandfather’s Gift
body:
The God of Gnomes has gifted you with a variety of talents.

Prerequisite: Patron deity is a god of gnomes

Benefit: You gain a +2 divine bonus to Handle Animal and Perform (Oratory).

The Book of Divine Magic. Copyright 2009, 4 Winds Fantasy Gaming; Authors Connie J. Thomson and Robert W. Thomson, with Katheryn Bauer and Sean O’Connor.
